old_article.headline: Spain beat Germany 81–58 to take bronze at the FIBA Women’s Basketball World Cup 2026
old_article.deck: Iyana Martin led Spain with 22 points; Nyara Sabally scored 13 for Germany.
body: Spain won the bronze medal game of the FIBA Women’s Basketball World Cup 2026 81–58 over Germany at Uber Arena in Berlin on Sunday, September 13, taking bronze.
Iyana Martin led Spain with 22 points, 4 rebounds and 8 assists, and Raquel Carrera added 15 points.
For Germany, Nyara Sabally finished with 13 points, 4 rebounds and 1 assists and Alexis Peterson scored 13.
No player on a current WNBA roster logged minutes in this game.
Spain shot 28 of 66 from the field and 9 of 25 from three, with 38 rebounds and 8 turnovers; Germany shot 20 of 51 and 7 of 23 from three, with 30 rebounds and 18 turnovers.
